author: Zintenka
body:
In this gamemode, you will have to destroy one of them ender crystals.

Anyway, you have to destroy the thingy with sword strikes. It has the health of 3 players combined. At 60 hearts. 

Depending on what sword you use the rules of a sword hitting a player applies here as well.

It HAS to be protected by mob spawners. They can be vanilla or custom. Just be mindful that the spawners should be in a protected region  meaning they cant be destroyed. The mobs will obviously be hostile to everyone. 

if the mob is super OP make only one of it. If it is vanilla or weak make 4 spawners.
